    If you buy a Global eSIM, you’ll enjoy a reliable connection across most populated areas and tourist destinations in more than 200 destinations, subject to local network availability. In rural or remote areas, such as mountainous regions, deserts, rainforests, sparsely populated islands, and during sea journeys, coverage may be more limited or unavailable. With our Global eSIM, you can travel between the included countries without changing eSIMs. Before travelling, check that every destination on your itinerary is included in the plan.
